stories.title: NatWest survey records sharper drop in Welsh business activity
stories.summary: Welsh private-sector firms cut jobs at the fastest rate in almost six years in May, according to a monthly business survey. stories.title: Wales’ housing minister pledges action for safe and affordable homes
stories.summary: Wales’ new housing minister has said everyone in Wales should have a “safe, warm home” – but admitted “this most basic of needs is out of reach for thousands of people”. stories.title: Around 200 runners took to the Airbus Broughton runway for a local children’s charity
stories.summary: Around 200 runners took to the runway at Airbus Broughton this morning for a 5km Fun Run. Airbus employees ran alongside friends, family and local residents in the event, which the company said was the first of its kind held on the runway. stories.title: North Wales Police e-bike and e-scooter seizures rise nine-fold in two years
stories.summary: North Wales Police seized 246 e-bikes and e-scooters last year, nine times the number taken off the roads two years earlier. stories.title: Mancot singing group marks 10 years with weekend performance
stories.summary: A singing group performed to a singalong audience at Mancot Village Hall over the weekend. The Singing for Pleasure group led the room through songs including Sweet Caroline and Amarillo.
